quality_note: BETA: ships the iter-3 DirectPF 'neutral' color model (Layer B) -- the best fit available, but NO gate numerically passes yet (skin ΔE00 median gate is <=1.0; best oracle-gain holdout result is 3.55, ~3.5x over). The gate numbers below (fitted/de00_refined) use ORACLE per-frame gains solved against the held-out frame's own true Nikon pixels -- they answer 'how good is the shared matrix+curves model alone', not 'how good is this bundle end-to-end'. Layer A actually shipped in this bundle (layer_a.json's percentile-stopgap-v1) is a BLIND estimator (no ground truth at inference time) and has not itself been numerically scored against the holdout set -- expect real end-to-end quality to sit nearer GATE7-RESULTS.json's 'population' (blind, no per-frame adaptation) baseline than the oracle numbers below. The quality tier flips to a higher grade when the skin gate (<=1.0 median ΔE00) passes, via a new bundle version -- not a code change (see NEGPY-INTEGRATION-PLAN.md's 'Honest quality note for the UI').
model_source: fit37/models/directpf_neutral.json (Gate-7 iteration 3, neutral variant, all 32 training frames)

gates.threshold_note: skin_median_de00 <= 1.0 and skin_p95_de00 <= 3.0 are the shipping gates (negfit/PLAN.md); none pass yet on any gain mode.

source_repo_note: Owner-authored numeric model data vendored into this repository. No Nikon ICC profile bytes are redistributed; see PROVENANCE.md.
